title: Report Alleges Alice Huang Helped Move 240,000 Nvidia Chips to China
summary: A report attributed to The Information alleges that Alice Huang helped move about 240,000 restricted Nvidia AI chips into China over a three-year relationship with CEO Jensen Huang, mostly H100 and H200 GPUs. The report ties the imports to roughly $7.5 billion and names Shanghai Century Litong and Singapore-based Megaspeed among the companies involved. These are unverified allegations from a secondary report; the supplied item provides no independent confirmation, Nvidia response, or detail on how the alleged diversion worked.
